# fahadmunafparekh.com

> Fahad Munaf Parekh (Sir Fahad Munaf Parekh) — Economics tutor for CAIE 9708, O Level 2281 / 0455 and Edexcel. 200+ free recorded lectures, online classes and notes.

Key facts:
- Tutor: Fahad Munaf Parekh (also known as "Sir Fahad").
- Subjects: A Level Economics — AS and A2 (CAIE 9708 & Edexcel); O Level and IGCSE Economics (CAIE 2281 / 0455).
- Location: Karachi, Pakistan. In-person teaching plus live online classes across Pakistan and internationally.
- Teaching blocks: morning school and college sessions, evening academy sessions, and live online classes.
- Free resources: 203 full recorded lectures on YouTube, a previewable notes library, and 23 study guides on the blog.
- Enrolment: May/June 2027 session. Registration is handled over WhatsApp.
- Website: https://fahadmunafparekh.com

## Free recorded lectures

203 full-length Economics lectures, free to watch, grouped by level and then by topic series. Explained in Urdu, Hindi and English.

- O Level — CAIE 2281 / 0455: 75 lectures. Microeconomics (45), Macroeconomics (28), Syllabus & Exam Skills (2).
- AS Level — CAIE 9708: 80 lectures. Microeconomics (51), Macroeconomics (29).
- A2 Level — CAIE 9708: 48 lectures. Microeconomics (34), Macroeconomics (14).
